scope: Read-only comparison of seven external worktrees and imported-art/world original files. Main working tree intentionally excluded from branch comparison. Only this result file was written.

method.git: GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0; git -c core.quotePath=false status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=normal; rev-parse HEAD; symbolic-ref HEAD
method.originals: SHA-256 streaming read and byte length; art additionally compares recorded nanosecond mtime. No source writes, cleanup, or reverts.
method.limits: Full content hashing was limited to the 41 imported art originals and 7 world originals. Same HEAD and status entries do not establish unchanged content for every other external working-tree file. Report directory was inspected while report work could continue.

externalWorktrees.statusCaveat: Porcelain directory entries are not recursive file hashes. Equal status alone cannot prove every working file is unchanged.
